_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS layer (folio-assistant-sci) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`. The same shape as the platform's own docs/wireframes/index.json, which covered `cat-harness/editor-checkers` until 2026-11-09: cat-harness declared a page for a kind only this layer registers, so in a checkout without this layer the reference did not resolve (cat-harness#1150, item 3; owner card Q-CGI-1 A). A wireframe sits with the page it draws, as folio-assistant-core's do. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from the platform's docs/wireframes/ so the drawing renders here on its own.
